things.parcel: a small parcel, a cardboard box sealed with brown tape, a handwritten label on it with the number 4471
things.matches: a small worn cardboard matchbox slid half open, three wooden matches with red heads inside
things.cigarettes: a crumpled soft pack of cigarettes with no brand on it, two cigarettes left, one sticking out
things.map: a hand-drawn map on a sheet of paper folded in four, half unfolded: pencil lines of streets and a few crosses, no names on it
things.valve: a radio valve: a small glass vacuum tube on a black base with metal pins, its filament glowing faintly warm orange inside
things.paper_notebook: a small closed notebook bound in faded pale beige cloth, worn at the corners, a dark elastic band around it and a pencil tucked under the band; nothing written on it
things.athena_note: a sheet of plain paper folded in half, worn and fibrous, a smudge and one creased corner; nothing written on it, completely blank
things.athena_patrol_sheet: a single sheet of ruled paper folded once, worn at the folds, faint erased pencil pressure; no legible writing or numbers on it
things.athena_repair_slip: a narrow paper receipt slip, yellowing and curled at one corner; no legible print on it, blank

concierge.parcel: the same small parcel made neat and new: a clean white box with a soft grey ribbon round it and a small glowing cyan C mark on its lid, a crisp printed label with the number 4471
concierge.matches: the same matchbox made sleek and new: a matt black box slid half open, a small red warning triangle printed on it, three matches with red heads inside
concierge.cigarettes: the same soft pack made clean and new: a slim pale pack with a plain grey health warning band, two cigarettes left, one sticking out
concierge.map: the same hand-drawn map on clean, crisp white paper, folded in four and half unfolded, its pencil lines faint and tidy, as if it hardly mattered
concierge.valve: the same radio valve made a collector's curio: polished glass on a glossy black base, its filament glowing a soft warm amber, spotless
concierge.paper_notebook: the same notebook bound in neat dark blue cloth with an elastic strap, clean and new; nothing written on it
concierge.athena_note: the same folded sheet in clean bright white paper, softly lit, one corner creased; nothing written on it
concierge.athena_patrol_sheet: the same ruled sheet, clean and crisp, its lines faint; nothing written on it
concierge.athena_repair_slip: the same narrow receipt slip, clean white and curled at one corner; no print on it
